test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the 69th amendment to the Constitution of India?

options.text: Delhi made National Capital Region and given special status.
Introduced the Goods and Service Tax
Bodo, Dogri included as official languages
Voting age lowered from 21 to 18 years

solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi made National Capital Region and given special status**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **69th Amendment** to the Constitution of India was enacted in **1991**.
 
• This amendment granted **special status to the Union Territory of Delhi** by redesignating it as the **National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi**.
 
• The amendment also provided for the creation of a **Legislative Assembly and a Council of Ministers** for the NCT of Delhi.
 
• The Chief Minister of Delhi would be the head of the Council of Ministers, aiding and advising the Lieutenant Governor.
 
• This special status aimed to give Delhi partial statehood with a legislative assembly that could legislate on all matters except public order, police, and land.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949 **and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written **constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule **of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The Union List has been amended several times to meet the evolving needs of the nation.
